programs.title: Trafficked with Mariana Van Zeller
programs.desc: Correspondent Mariana van Zeller has been following the trail of smugglers for over fifteen years.During his dangerous work, he meets not only criminals, but also representatives of the justice system, former prisoners and members of local communities.The journalist paints a shocking picture of the gray zone where billions of dollars are traded.The reporter will learn about the activities of counterfeiters, drug dealers, and the illegal sale of weapons, fentanyl and animals.Her interlocutors included Joe Exotic, the former owner of the controversial zoo.In 2019, he was sentenced to 22 years in prison.
